prompt: Elements `[88, 77, 66, 55, 44, 33, 22]` are placed into an array and converted into a Min-Heap using Floyd's bottom-up buildHeap algorithm. Which array representation satisfies the min-heap parent-child invariant `A[i] <= A[2i+1]` and `A[i] <= A[2i+2]`?
explanation: A valid binary min-heap must satisfy A[i] <= children for every parent. Bottom-up heapify rearranges `[88, 77, 66, 55, 44, 33, 22]` to `[22, 44, 33, 55, 77, 88, 66]`.
